steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. A test that passes and fails on the same commit is flaky.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Passes and fails on the same commit four times, no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner and fix the cause

findings.title: Quarantined with no date
findings.fix: Set a date to remove the quarantine

outcome.notChecked: Causes that need a code reading.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] test-upload.spec:19  Flaky test with no owner.

[low] test-report.spec:26  Quarantined with no date.

Not checked: Causes that need a code reading.
pros: Flags a test that both passes and fails on the same commit more than twice, a flaky test with no owner, and a test quarantined with no date.
cons: Not checked: Causes that need a code reading.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-flaky-test-review skill on the records for this review.
